T2.APPEAR_MARKET_ID appearMarketId, T11.FINPROD_MARKET_ID conFinprodMarketId, T12.REP_ASSET_TYPE repAssetType from FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT T8.FINPROD_ID,T7.CREDIT_FLAG ,T7.PFLSH,T7.HAP_CREDIT_AMT ,T7.CUSTOMER_ID FROM CREDIT_LINES T7 LEFT JOIN CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL T8 ON T7.CUSTOMER_ID = T8.SEQNO) T ON (T.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID OR T.CUSTOMER_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID) left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T2 on T2.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T3 on T3.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID left join MST_CALENDAR_INFO T4 on T4.CALENDAR_ID = T1.CALENDAR_ID left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T5 on T5.CUSTOMER_ID = T1.ISSUER left join REP_ASSET_BOND T6 on T6.REP_FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID left join PA_FIN_PRODUCT T9 on T9.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID
left join FIN_POST_INVEST_INFO T10 ON T10.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID
left join FIN_PRODUCT_CONVERTIBLE T13 ON T13.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT T11 ON T11.FINPROD_ID = T13.CON_FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN REP_ASSET_DEPT T12 on T1.FINPROD_ID = T12.REP_FINPROD_ID
( T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
OR T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodId} ) and T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} and rownum = 1
